method: Recomputed from locked original data-generation functions; no model training/scoring; canonical compact JSON SHA256. Hashes were produced after the campaign, not prospective sealed-panel hashes.
novelty: Four whole operator-pair templates held out; ordered single-operation operand splits. Symmetric operand swaps were not globally held out. E8 life probes of development operations use the original life-panel recipe, not a newly independent split.
